Name: Shie-style Joja Sam and Shane
Author: xoPeridotTea
Description:
Joja portraits for Sam and Shane to go with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]SHIE'S PORTRAITS[/url] mod since they were missing from the original mod.  I tried to get these to match their original Joja portraits outfits as much ass possible.

[b]MOD REQUIREMENTS[/b]:
[list]
[*]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)
[*]PyTK (Platonymous Toolkit)
[*]SHIE'S PORTRAITS
[/list]
[b]To install the files:[/b]
1. unzip the .zip file
2. place the unzipped .png files in the SHIE'S PORTRAITS folder within your Portraiture mod folder
(i.e. - D:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\Shie's Portraits)

Downloads.Description: Missing Joja portraits mod (Sam and Shane only)
